title: Verification finding
description: One issue raised by any scanner (security or functionality). Stable across tools so the triangulator can match across sources.

id.description: sha1(source_scanner|file|line|category|title)[:16]. Deterministic across runs of the SAME scanner; lets triangulator use exact match as a fast path before falling back to fuzzy match.

source_scanner.description: Which scanner produced this finding. `manual` is reserved for human-added findings.

file.description: Repo-relative path. NULL when the finding isn't tied to a specific file (e.g., dep CVE on requirements.txt is fine; but a Mythos config check might apply globally).
